raw.rationale: DAPT is a gamma-secretase inhibitor that primarily affects NOTCH signaling, so selective killing is expected mainly in NOTCH-addicted lineages such as T-ALL, but among these solid-tumor lineages only CNS/neural and possibly skin or breast subsets have plausible NOTCH dependence; PRISM single-agent screens generally show few selective lineages at 2.5 µM. Thus probabilities are low across all listed lineages, with slight enrichment for central_nervous_system and skin.
